description.zh: 主动式记忆系统：AI 自己判断何时写入、何时检索、如何沉淀。三层结构 L1事件 → L2经验 → L3原则，艾宾浩斯复习，记忆进化留版本史。注入的只是索引与任务指令，正文始终不进上下文。
description.en: Active memory: the AI decides when to write, when to retrieve, and how to consolidate. 3 layers L1 event -> L2 lesson -> L3 , Ebbinghaus review, versioned evolution. Only an index plus task instructions are injected; bodies never enter context.
description.default: Active memory system with layered consolidation
